name: Ordinary Body
description: Flesh and bone like any other. The heavens expect nothing of you.

name: Robust Bones
description: Thick bones and dense sinew. Hard to break, slow to tire.

name: Keen Spirit Sense
description: Your soul is unusually sharp; you notice what others cannot.

name: Spirit-Sensitive Body
description: Ambient qi clings to your skin like morning dew.

name: Sickly Body
description: A frail vessel. Physicians shook their heads at your birth.

name: Withered Meridians
description: Your meridians are narrow and brittle. Every thread of qi is a struggle, which has taught you to think deeply.

name: Jade Bone Body
description: Bones like warm jade that resist decay and steady the foundation.

name: Golden Bell Body
description: Your skin rings like bronze when struck.

name: Verdant Spring Body
description: Life wells up within you. Wounds close and herbs flourish at your touch.

name: Earth Vein Body
description: You feel the dragon veins of the land as if they were your own blood.

name: Tidal Heart Body
description: Your qi ebbs and surges with the moon, endlessly renewing.

name: Hundred Poison Body
description: Venom pools harmlessly in your blood. Others fear your touch.

name: Ghost-Touched Body
description: You were born at the hour the gates of the dead stood open. You see what walks unseen.

name: Innate Sword Body
description: Sword intent stirs in your bones. Any blade in your hand becomes an extension of your will.

name: Nine Yin Profound Body
description: Bitter yin cold coils in your marrow. Coveted as a cauldron by demonic cultivators.

name: Nine Yang Blazing Body
description: Your blood burns like a furnace. Yang fire roars at every heartbeat.

name: Myriad Thunder Body
description: Heavenly lightning recognises you as kin. Tribulations are a feast, not a trial.

name: Heaven-Defying Chaos Body
description: A body that should not exist. You cultivate with terrifying speed, and the heavens despise you for it.

name: Stone Skin
description: Skin like weathered granite: blades skid off it, though it makes you slow.

name: Fox Spirit Grace
description: A trace of fox spirit in your bearing. People find themselves agreeing with you.

name: Fortunate Star
description: Born under a lucky star. Things fall your way more often than they should.

name: Swift Wind Body
description: Light as a leaf on the wind; you are gone before the blow lands.

name: Thunder-Tempered Body
description: Struck by lightning as a child and lived. The heavens' bolts know you.

name: Ice Soul Body
description: A soul as clear and cold as winter ice. Cold qi cannot take hold in you.

name: Phoenix Marrow
description: Embers smoulder in your bones. Wounds close; years come slowly.

name: Beast-Blood Vessel
description: Your blood drinks in other blood. Beast bloodlines take root in you easily.

name: Heaven-Gifted Hands
description: Fingers that remember every craft. Furnaces, forges and brushes obey you.

name: Seer's Eyes
description: Clouded eyes that see what has not happened yet.

name: Dragon Vein Body
description: A thread of true dragon runs through your meridians. Power, and an appetite for blood.

name: Heavenly Dao Body
description: The dao speaks to you as plainly as a friend. The heavens resent it.

name: Iron Marrow Body
description: Metal qi settles in your marrow like ore in a seam. You are heavier than you look.

name: Spirit Bamboo Body
description: You grow straight and supple, and bend without breaking. The years pass you gently.

name: Mirror Lake Heart
description: Your mind is still water. What falls into it is seen clearly to the bottom.

name: Ember Blood Body
description: Your blood runs hot enough to scald. Fire leaps eagerly from your hands.

name: Purple Lightning Meridians
description: Violet sparks crawl along your meridians. Your strikes arrive before the thunder does.

name: Primordial Mountain Body
description: The bones of the first mountains were laid down like yours. Nothing moves you that you do not allow.

name: Ten-Thousand-Year Frost Body
description: Cold older than the world sleeps in you. Your breath frosts the air in summer.

name: Boundless Gale Body
description: The wind does not carry you; it follows you. No road is long to you.

name: Taiji Body
description: Water and fire turn in you without quarrel, each the seed of the other. The dao of balance comes naturally.

name: Five Phases Harmony Body
description: Where others' mixed roots muddy each other, yours turn like a wheel: each phase feeds the next.

name: Bottomless Dantian
description: Your dantian swallows medicine like the sea swallows rain, and is never sated.

name: Vast Sea of Consciousness
description: Your inner sea has no far shore. Soul attacks drown in it.

name: Undying Body
description: Death keeps forgetting your name. Your flesh knits as you watch.

name: Cloud-Treading Feet
description: You walk as if the ground were a suggestion.

name: Star-Crossed Body
description: Ill luck dogs you, and every misfortune has taught you something.

name: Primordial Retribution Body
description: Every ancient fell to you, and every thread of their karma runs through your flesh now. The heavens themselves step aside.

name: Karmic Sovereign Body
description: You cut down an ancient in all thirty-three of their bodies. The weight of that deed has become your body: cause and effect bend around you.

name: Body of Samsara Reversed
description: You pulled a soul back out of the wheel. Something of the wheel came with it, and stayed in you: death has trouble holding you.

name: Thunder-Defying Soul Body
description: You met the heavens' lightning with your soul and turned it aside, bolt after bolt. Your sea of consciousness is vast and still, and the thunder remembers.

name: Myriad Beast Tyrant Body
description: A thousand beasts fell to you, and their blood soaked into yours. Beasts lower their heads when you pass.

name: Asura Body
description: Slaughter has become your dao and your flesh. Wounds close as fast as you take them; your blade never tires.

name: War God Body
description: You stood alone above every champion of the world. Your body has made itself into a weapon worthy of that.

name: Heaven-Forging Hands
description: Ten masterpieces passed through your hands, and your hands have become a masterpiece themselves.

name: Thunder-Tempered Vajra Body
description: You took the heavens' lightning on your bare flesh, bolt after bolt, and it could not break you. Every bone in you is lightning-forged now.

name: Boundless Thunder Sea Body
description: You held the heavens' lightning back with a sea of qi, bolt after bolt. Your dantian drank the storm, and it is a storm still.

name: Blood Demon Body
description: Your blood runs hot and hungry. What you kill, your flesh wants to swallow.

name: Nether Corpse Body
description: Cold as a grave, slow to rot, slower to die. The living keep their distance.

name: Heavenly Devil Heart
description: Your heart has no cracks for a demon to grip. Demonic scriptures read to you like lullabies.

name: Myriad Soul Vessel
description: A sea of consciousness wide enough to hold a thousand stolen souls without drowning in them.

name: Demon-Quelling Body
description: Five demonic sects fell to your hand. Heaven has made you its blade against the dark, so long as your heart stays clean.

name: Heaven-Upholding Body
description: Eight demonic sects lie in ruins behind you. The heavens lean on your shoulders, and ask that you stay worthy.

name: Sect-Devouring Demon Body
description: Five righteous sects drowned in their own blood. Their ruin feeds you, so long as the world keeps fearing you.

name: Heaven-Defying Devil Body
description: Eight righteous sects are ash. You are what mothers warn of, and the dark rewards you for it, so long as you stay what you are.

name: Thousand-Faces Body
description: Hunted under a hundred names and caught under none. Your face slides off memory; the world never learns what you did.

name: Fallen Righteous Body
description: A body heaven made its blade, gone dull with your sins. It drags at you until your karma is clean again.

name: Broken Devil Body
description: A devil's body gone soft with mercy. It gnaws at you until you are feared and wicked again.

name: Myriad Venom Body
description: Every poison under heaven runs in your blood as harmlessly as water, and the worst of them rides your touch.

name: Body of Endless Rebirth
description: Three times the wheel turned and three times your soul came through it whole. Death has learned your face and lets you pass.

name: Myriad Dao Body
description: Every dao under heaven has settled in you to its root. Insight comes to you the way breath does.

name: Body of the Great Dao
description: Every dao understood to its end and woven into one. There is no seam left between you and the way of heaven.

name: Withering Blood Body
description: Thin, slow blood. Your senses are keen, but a cut takes a season to close.

name: Frail Soul Body
description: Quick hands and a soul that sits loosely in them: a blow to the mind lands far deeper than it should.

name: Stone Heart Body
description: Cold and heavy as a mountain. Little moves you, soul strikes included; people find you hard to warm to.

name: Porous Meridians
description: Wide-open meridians drink qi greedily, and everything else with it: poison and cold qi bite twice as deep.

name: Glass Meridians
description: Flawless, clear and brittle. Qi races through them; a breakthrough or a tribulation can shatter them.

name: Burning Life Body
description: Your life burns like a torch: fierce, bright and short.

name: Overlord Body
description: Your meridians are sealed to heaven and earth and your sea of consciousness is shut like a tomb. Everything the heavens would have poured into qi and soul pours into the flesh instead: you will never draw in a wisp of spiritual qi or open a divine eye, and you will never need to.

name: Cauldron Heart Body
description: A furnace burns steady in your chest. Flames lean toward your hand as if to be told what to do.

name: Anvil Bone Body
description: Your bones ring under the hammer like good iron. Metal remembers your touch.

name: Ink Spirit Body
description: Spirit ink flows from your fingers as if it were your own blood. Runes come to you half-written.

name: Array Vein Body
description: You feel the flow of qi through stone and flag the way others feel the wind.

name: Thousand-Thread Body
description: A thousand fine threads of soul run from your fingertips, and dead things answer them.

name: Spirit Soil Body
description: Seeds quicken in your palm. Spirit herbs grow toward you as toward the sun.

name: Heaven-Reading Eyes
description: You see the threads of fate as faint lines in the air. Heaven has not yet noticed you looking.

name: Gu Nest Body
description: Worms and insects settle on you as if you were home. Gu fear you and love you at once.

name: Beast-Kin Body
description: Wild things smell their own kind on you. Beasts that would bite another lower their heads to you.
